adjourned.dataset: ECI statistical report, Rajasthan 2018, '10 - Detailed Results' (published as PDF only); only seat 67 (Ramgarh) is used
adjourned.note: Ramgarh's poll was adjourned and held on 28 January 2019; the report includes it. Its seat summary gives the declaration as 31 January 2019 but the polling date as 7 December 2018, the original schedule.

adjourned.obtained: Downloaded from the Chief Electoral Officer, Odisha on 2026-11-18 by Priyadarshi Amar; details in data/raw/eci_reports/adjourned/MANIFEST.csv and fetch_log.jsonl
adjourned.dataset: Form 20, final result sheet, 'Adjourned election to 96-Patkura AC'
adjourned.note: ECI's 2019 statistical report leaves Patkura out (its Detailed Results, in odisha_2019/, has 146 of 147 seats) and no index card was found, so the source is Form 20. Form 20 gives no date; the poll of 20 July 2019 is ECI's schedule of 4 July as reported by ANI and PTI. Form 20 does not record candidates' sex, age or category.
